newsitem.title: USA: ASA Holdings Inc Feb load factor rises.
newsitem.headline: ASA Holdings Inc Feb load factor rises.

text.p: Atlantic Southeast Airlines Inc, a subsidiary of ASA Holdings Inc, said on Friday that its February load factor increased to 47.2 percent from 46.5 percent.

Revenue passenger miles in February decreased to 63.0 million from 63.7 million a year ago, the regional carrier said. Available seat miles in February fell 2.5 percent to 133.5 million from 137.0 million, Atlantic Southeast said.
Atlantic Southeast said its load factor for the two months ended February 1997 increased to 45.5 percent from 44.9 percent in the comparable period in 1996.

Revenue passenger miles for the year-to-date period increased to 125.4 million from 124.2 million last year, while available seat miles fell to 275.6 million the first two months of 1997 from 276.8 million in last year's period, the company said.
